# skip_blank behavior
def indent_skip(text, prefix, skip_blank=True):
    out=[]
    for line in text.splitlines(keepends=True):
        if skip_blank and line.strip()=='':
            out.append(line)
        else:
            out.append(prefix+line)
    return ''.join(out)
